recommendations.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
recommendations.verdict: 里程碑级：形式化验证第一次跑到了真实开源库的机器码层面，而不是玩具证明。
recommendations.reason: Anthropic 与 Theorem 合作，让 Claude 在 123 个 OSS-Fuzz 库里对编译后的 RISC-V 机器码写证明，顺手挖出人类测试几年没发现的 bug。这是「AI 找 bug」之后必须补上的一环：证明没有 bug。
key_points: 覆盖 239 个 fuzz 入口、123 个库，证明「任何小于 64MB 的输入都不会崩」，合计约 1.8 亿行 Rocq 证明
证明过程本身发现了真实漏洞：约 20MB 稀有布局才触发的计数器下溢、需要 64MB 输入与 2GB 内存的越界读，以及 libexpat 的 CVE-2026-56132
可信基只剩三样：RISC-V 与 Linux 进程语义模型、定理陈述、Rocq 检查器；模型越强、证明越便宜，且证明可复用（共享工作区少用 17% token）
代价仍高：证明动辄数亿 token；限制是单线程静态 musl 二进制，与线上 x86/ARM + glibc 动态链接仍有差距
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是「AI 让找 bug 变便宜」之后的另一半拼图——让证明「没有这类 bug」也变便宜，而且第一次落在生产软件的编译产物上。

1. 做法很聪明：不追求给整个程序写规格说明，而是把已有的 fuzz 测试改写成规格。「这个 fuzz 入口在 RISC-V 上跑，任何小于 64MB 的输入都不会崩」——于是原本靠暴力变异碰运气的模糊测试，变成了一条可以被证明的定理。Claude 证明了 239 个入口、横跨 123 个 OSS-Fuzz 库，产出约 1.8 亿行 Rocq；典型证明 60 万行，对应中位数只有 1.8 万条 RISC-V 指令的二进制。

2. 证明过程本身就是漏洞挖掘器，而且挖的是 fuzzer 结构上碰不到的角落：一个解压器里的计数器下溢导致越界写，只在约 20MB、特定布局的输入上触发；一个图像解码器需要 64MB 输入加 2GB 内存才暴露越界读；还有需要跨两个文件句柄的特定调用序列才出现的读越界，以及 libexpat 的 CVE-2026-56132 被重新发现。逻辑类 bug 也能抓：某库「限制可加载文件」的功能并非在所有路径上生效。对照点是 fuzzer 通常把输入压到 1MB 级。

3. 可信基（trusted base）被压到很小，这是工程上最值钱的部分：1.8 亿行证明几乎不需要人读，因为 Rocq 检查器会验；开发者真正要信的是 RISC-V 与 Linux 进程语义模型、被证明的那几条定理陈述、以及检查器本身。换句话说，审计面从「几十万行 C 代码」缩成「几个形式语义模型」，而且这个面不随被验证项目数量增长。

4. 局限写得比宣传诚实：形式化验证不等于无 bug，规格与真实机器不一致时证明就失效（当前是单线程静态 musl 二进制，线上多是 x86/ARM + glibc 动态链接）；ASan 也覆盖不了全部内存安全问题；即便每个入口都证了，库里的死代码与调用方的误用仍在射程之外。这几条决定了短期内它是「补强」而非「替代」测试。

5. 经济性正在快速变好：Opus 5.5 在 36 个小验证任务上比 Opus 5 少用约 40% token 就证完一半；让 agent 共享已完成的证明可再省 17%，部分单干失败的 agent 靠抄同伴的证明过关——这和 Mathlib 靠复用长到 30 万条定理是同一个机制，而依赖是幂律分布的：先证 glibc、OpenSSL、cURL 这类少数关键库，覆盖面就上去了。

我的推荐：值得完整读一遍，尤其是「怎么把测试改写成规格」和「可信基只剩三样」这两节。它给出一条现实路径：不用重写代码、不用换语言，先在二进制层面把最关键的依赖证掉。如果你在做安全、编译器、或者任何「测试跑了几万亿次还是不放心」的系统，这是今年最该读的一篇。

recommendations.title: The Pulse: Anthropic builds its own source control system
recommendations.verdict: 一个 3500 人公司被迫自研源码控制系统的完整现场记录，附赠一场开源抄袭争议。
recommendations.reason: 四个月里每天合并量从 2500 涨到 3 万，25GB 的 monorepo 每天 2500 万次 checkout，git 的镜像方案直接撞墙。想看清 agent 规模化之后工程基础设施会先在哪断掉，这篇给的是第一手数字。
key_points: 2026 年 5 月日均合并约 2500 次，9 月已超 3 万次，四个月 12 倍；约 3000 名员工每人常开 10–15 个 Claude agent
瓶颈从写代码转移到「为人规模设计的开发基础设施」：源码控制、构建、CI；git 的离线假设与镜像横向扩展在 25GB 仓库上失效
自研 Scion（Rust，changeset 存 Spanner、blob 存 GCS，内容寻址）与 Antique（Go + React 的评审平台），核心团队只有 7 人，monorepo 已 100% 迁出 git
Mononoke 作者公开指控 Scion 抄袭其数据模型与 Bonsai 结构，Anthropic 在投诉后补了一条小注脚，并以「人力不够」为由不开源
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：当 agent 把代码产出放大一个数量级，最先崩的不是模型也不是人，而是 git 这类「为人类节奏设计」的基础设施。

1. 数字本身就是结论：2026 年 5 月 Anthropic 日均合并约 2500 次代码变更，9 月超过 3 万次，四个月 12 倍；约 3000 名员工，每人常态开 10–15 个 Claude agent；光是 CI 每天就要 2500 万次 checkout；monorepo 工作副本 25GB。作者 Gergely Orosz 的判断是：3500 人的公司，产出对标 3.5 万到 7 万人的组织。

2. 为什么 git 撑不住，文章讲得很具体，不是「git 慢」这种废话：其一，git 的设计假设客户端会离线，回到线上要追平分支，而 Anthropic 的客户端始终在线，为离线付出的代价变成低效 checkout 与多余数据传输；其二，git 的横向扩展靠镜像——主节点收写、推给上百个镜像、客户端分散拉取，一旦仓库超过镜像磁盘容量就没法再加；其三，3 万个 PR/天带来的评审与合并队列压力，GitHub 的评审体验也接不住。

3. 替代品的工程细节值得抄作业：Scion 服务端与客户端都用 Rust，changeset 放 Google Spanner、大文件放 GCS，数据内容寻址且写入后不变，所以缓存层承担了大部分负载——合并量涨了 10 倍以上也没触发自动扩容。可用性上把默认的三副本加到更多、改成多地域复制，再加全量备份与 Spanner 的按时间点恢复。评审平台 Antique 是 Go 后端 + React 前端。整套东西 7 个人维护（4 人核心、3 人做代码搜索与合并队列）。迁移 100% 完成，Claude 在迁移里出了大力，作者形容为「自愈式」：覆盖到 99% 就强切，剩下由 Claude 补。

4. 争议不该被略过：Mononoke（Meta 开源的 Mercurial 服务端）作者公开指控 Scion 抄袭其数据模型与 Bonsai 序列化结构，并称存在人员重叠；Anthropic 最初的文章没有致谢，投诉后才补了一条小注脚，并以「带宽不够、代码变动太快」为由拒绝开源。对照 Meta 当年照样开源了 Sapling 与 Mononoke，这个解释站不住。读这篇时把技术部分和这件事分开看：架构经验可用，致谢与开源态度是另一个问题。

5. 对大多数团队的现实意义：作者判断极少公司会真的自研 VCS，但「agent 把合并量推高 10 倍后 git 会不会坏」已经从假设变成可观测的问题。市场上出现了一批主打 AI 规模的 git 兼容方案（Entire、Cursor Origin、Code Storage），GitHub 也在补可靠性与扩展性。真正该带走的不是「去写个 Scion」，而是：先量一下自己的 checkout、CI、评审队列在什么量级开始非线性劣化。

我的推荐：当作一份「agent 规模化后的基础设施故障报告」读。前半段的数字与 git 失效机制值得逐条对照自己团队；后半段关于 Mononoke 的争议，是判断一家实验室工程文化的重要旁证。

recommendations.title: How we cut GitLab Duo Code Review's cost by 98%
recommendations.verdict: 少见的把「成本怎么降下来」拆到每一段的实测报告，方法和结论都能直接搬。
recommendations.reason: 同一个 agent、同一批 50 个 PR，单 PR 成本从 0.589 美元降到 0.0135 美元，F1 还略升。关键不是换了便宜模型，而是先量出钱花在哪一段，再逐段改、改完回头重测。
key_points: 四段流水线里评审段占 65% 账单，仅 Sonnet 5 的输出就占三分之一——每次评审约 1.86 万输出 token，几乎全是推理
只换模型到 DeepSeek V4 Flash 全段：成本降 85.3%（0.086 美元/PR），F1 48.4%，延迟 0.37 倍；但 3/50 个 PR 超过 256K 窗口触发 11 次回退
加上规则式上下文压缩后最大提示从 480K 降到 109K，全部装进窗口，成本 0.0135 美元/PR（−97.7%），F1 47.2%
没用的招也写了：推理档位调到 max 只把召回从 38.9% 抬到 52.8%，F1 几乎不动、延迟 3.5 倍；prompt 缓存在这里没有可复用前缀
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是一篇可以直接照抄方法的成本工程案例——先按阶段归因，再一次只改一个变量，改完回头重测之前的所有结论。

1. 先把钱花在哪说清楚。GitLab Duo Code Review 是四段式流水线（探索仓库树、抓取相关文件、分析、评审），默认全段 Claude Sonnet 5，基线 0.589 美元/PR、F1 46.4%。账单集中在评审段：65%，其中光输出就占三分之一——Sonnet 5 每次评审写约 1.86 万输出 token，几乎全是推理；探索与抓取合计 27%，分析 9%。这种归因比「换个便宜模型试试」有用得多，因为它告诉你哪一段值得动。

2. 第一个发现反直觉：压缩上下文省的钱比算术预期少。用规则（不做摘要）把变更文件的上下文窗口化成「每个 hunk 前后各 25 行」，并把带双重行号标签的逐行 diff 改写成标准 unified diff，中位提示从 59K 降到 32K token，评审段上下文花费降 62%。但总成本只降了 19.4%——因为 Sonnet 5 在压缩后反而写了更多推理（1.86 万涨到 2.38 万输出 token）。这条对做 agent 成本优化的人很关键：输入省下来的钱，可能被模型「想得更多」吃掉。

3. 第二个发现是「换模型要看阶段」。Haiku 4.5 放在探索和抓取两段，选中的文件和 Sonnet 5 一样，成本降 15.4%（叠加压缩 34.6%）；一旦放到分析和评审段，质量立刻掉，评审段掉得最狠。真正的大头在评审的推理，只能换出 Claude 家族：DeepSeek V4 Flash（自建 vLLM on H100）按 Together 公开价，输入便宜 14 倍、输出便宜 36 倍，全段替换后 0.086 美元/PR，降 85.3%，F1 48.4%，延迟 0.37 倍。

4. 为什么停在 85%：自建部署只接 256K 以内的提示，更长的留给 Sonnet 5 兜底；不做压缩时部分评审提示到了 480K，50 个 PR 里有 3 个越界、产生 11 次回退调用——6% 的 PR 吃掉了剩余成本的 77%，典型的尾部分布。把压缩重新加回来，最大提示从 480K 降到 109K，全部装进窗口，成本到 0.0135 美元/PR（−97.7%），F1 47.2%，延迟 0.35 倍。注意同一项改动的价值变了：在 Sonnet 5 前面它是 19.4% 的成本优化，在 256K 部署前面它是「能不能用这个模型」的开关。

5. 边界条件写得诚实，读的时候要一起读：配置是在用于评分的那 50 个 PR 上选的，属于样本内调参；F1 只是单一公开基准、两个裁判模型；换新代码库是否成立未验证；具体设置已过时（GitLab 之后把 Duo 换到了 Sonnet 5.5）。能带走的只有方法：按阶段量成本、一次改一个变量、每改一项就回头重测旧结论。另外质量结构也变了——终版更准（精确率 46.8% 对 41.9%）但召回略低（47.6% 对 52.0%），输出约 9000 token 而不是 1.86 万。

items.title: ‘If Anything Happens to This Guy … Everyone Is Screwed' (13 minute read)
items.summary: Ondřej Surý is one of the volunteers who helps maintain and automate patches for PHP. He alone is responsible for most of the world's distribution of PHP. His work, along with just a handful of others, has allowed countless websites and organizations to fix the recently revealed PHP vulnerabilities quickly. He's become arguably the unsung hero of the entire internet, despite the fact that the only compensation he receives for his work is from donations. This article features an interview with Surý where he discusses the unfolding AI-cybersecurity crisis, how the internet's infrastructure is maintained by small crews of volunteers, and how it feels to save the web.
items.score_reason: 大西洋月刊：一个人维护全球 PHP 补丁分发，开源关键基础设施的单点风险。
items.highlight: PHP 曝出两个可远程执行代码的严重漏洞，约七成网站受影响；披露被提前泄露后，攻击尝试在数小时内从数千增至数百万，而捷克志愿者 Ondřej Surý 靠多年自动化打包经验连夜发出补丁，并直言开源维护已近剥削。
items.excerpt: On Tuesday, the world found out about two massive security vulnerabilities in PHP, a programming language that is used by roughly 70 percent of websites. The flaw was discovered by cybersecurity researchers using a frontier model from OpenAI.

items.title: Supervisory Engineering Work (17 minute read)
items.summary: Supervisory engineering work is a different job from software engineering and so requires a different system around it.
items.score_reason: Annie Vella：监督型工程工作与写代码是两种职业，需要不同的组织配套。
items.highlight: 作者把「监督式工程」追溯到人因学的监督控制理论：AI 代理接管写码后，工程师转向指挥、评估与纠错；实验显示自动化程度越高，人对系统的理解与情境意识越弱，接管也更慢，因此需要重新设计岗位、信号与培训。
items.excerpt: Automation is not new in software development. We’ve been automating parts of our process for decades - build pipelines, testing, deployments. With AI, we’re now able to automate work that previously required humans with specialised skills to do by hand - specifically, the writing of the code.

items.title: How Researchers Tested OpenAI's Internal Agent Monitoring (6 minute read)
items.summary: METR and Redwood Research conducted a three-week security assessment with access to OpenAI's internal infrastructure, identifying vulnerabilities that could allow AI agents to evade monitoring, bypass sandbox restrictions, or conceal actions.
items.score_reason: METR 与 Redwood 对 OpenAI 内部 agent 监控做三周红队，列出逃逸路径。
items.highlight: METR 与 Redwood 研究人员进入 OpenAI 内部三周，实测其异步失准监控系统，发现压缩事件未被监控、两个能关闭监控的请求头、沙箱逃逸等漏洞，并提出让监控难以被规避的设计原则。
items.excerpt: For three weeks, from July 21st to August 11th, a METR employee and a Redwood Research employee conducted a pilot high-access exercise to stress-test OpenAI’s internal misalignment monitoring system.

items.title: How we deploy Trillion-parameter frontier models on Cerebras (6 minute read)
items.summary: A single Cerebras WSE-3T wafer has 44 GB of on-chip memory. Trillion-parameter frontier models need terabytes of memory for their weights alone. This post explains how the company splits a large frontier model across multiple WSE-3T wafers. It covers how models are filled into on-chip memory, how models are mapped across multiple chips, and how Cerebras handles a high number of concurrent requests.
items.score_reason: Cerebras 单晶圆 44GB 片上内存，如何把万亿参数模型切分部署。
items.highlight: Cerebras 把 3 万亿参数的 Kimi K3 按层铺到 59 片 WSE-3T 晶圆：每片 44GB 片上内存直接放整层权重，稠密层余量留给 KV 缓存，晶圆之间只传激活值，不同请求在流水线各级并行推进。
items.excerpt: One of the most frequently asked questions we get is how we deploy large models on Cerebras wafer-scale chips. A single Cerebras WSE-3T wafer has 44 GB of on-chip memory, and trillion-parameter frontier models need terabytes for their weights alone.

items.title: What the heck is the Public Suffix List? (21 minute read)
items.summary: The Public Suffix List records the boundaries browsers and password managers need to distinguish independently controlled sites on shared domains. Its rules prevent cookies and saved credentials from crossing tenant boundaries, but growing demand leaves volunteers reviewing increasingly complex submissions. The article explains why DNS has not replaced the list and why using it for unrelated controls can create problems.
items.score_reason: ngrok 长文拆解 Public Suffix List，解释 cookie 与凭证的租户边界。
items.highlight: 公共后缀列表是志愿者维护的纯文本文件，决定浏览器、密码管理器与 CA 的域名边界。私有段六年涨 10.8 倍，2026 年已收 684 个 PR，多数未合并，维护者正讨论提高准入门槛。
items.excerpt: The Public Suffix List is a registry of domain names that browsers, password managers, certificate authorities, and a heck of a lot of other software use to know exactly where one website ends and another begins.

items.title: The Current Landscape of OAuth Attacks (16 minute read)
items.summary: Attackers have shifted to stealing OAuth access and refresh tokens, bypassing MFA and surviving password resets, using device code phishing, consent screens for impersonated or vaguely named apps, and redirect_uri abuse that sends victims from real IdP domains to attacker pages. Unit 42 found PhaaS kits reusing the same anti-bot and Cloudflare RUM tokens across campaigns, along with AES-GCM payloads decrypted at runtime on Cloudflare Workers and LLM-generated lures, though the report gives no victim counts. Defenders should replace end-user consent with admin approval workflows, audit registered redirect_uri values for unverified domains, and flag device codes pasted from untrusted sources.
items.score_reason: Unit 42 梳理 OAuth 攻击面：设备码钓鱼、同意页仿冒、redirect_uri 滥用。
items.highlight: 文章把OAuth钓鱼归为账户劫持、权限劫持与恶意跳转三类，逐条拆解设备码钓鱼和授权码窃取手法，指出令牌在认证之后签发，能绕过MFA、耐受改密，条件访问与IP封锁均失效，防御须前移到授权环节。
items.excerpt: As enterprises continue to roll out multi-factor authentication (MFA), attackers have adapted. Rather than only stealing credentials, attackers have shifted to stealing Open Authorization (OAuth) tokens, the keys that govern what applications can do on your behalf.

items.title: State of Post-Quantum Cryptography implementations (17 minute read)
items.summary: Quarkslab's differential fuzzer DeltAFLy found that seven of ten tested libraries, including liboqs, AWS-LC, and libcrux, accepted malformed ML-DSA private keys with out-of-range coefficients that can bias rejection sampling and leak secret key material, while only OpenSSL, BoringSSL, and SymCrypt rejected them. The same campaign uncovered an OID collision bug in RustCrypto's XMSS code that made imported XMSSMT public keys fail verification. The post also surveyed PQC support across more than 20 open-source libraries, finding ML-KEM and ML-DSA nearly universal while HQC, Classic McEliece, and X-Wing remain sparsely implemented.
items.score_reason: Quarkslab 差分测试十个 PQC 库，七个接受畸形 ML-DSA 私钥。
items.highlight: 文章盘点OpenSSL、BoringSSL、liboqs等二十余个库的后量子算法支持，再用差分模糊测试发现ML-KEM与ML-DSA密钥校验不一致，以及RustCrypto的XMSS解析缺陷。
items.excerpt: In this blogpost, we first review the landscape of Post-Quantum Cryptography implementations across some of the most popular cryptographic libraries. Following that, we present the results of a differential fuzzing campaign on few of the presented implementations.

items.title: “ignore the slop” (3 minute read)
items.summary: curl maintainer Daniel Stenberg said every one of the hundreds of vulnerability reports curl received in recent months involved AI, but hallucinated slop had largely disappeared since spring 2026, leaving maintainers with a harder problem of high-volume, accurate, overly wordy reports they cannot ignore.
items.score_reason: curl 维护者：AI 生成的漏洞报告已退潮为可用噪声，维护者负担的真实变化。
items.highlight: curl 创始人 Daniel Stenberg 反驳「无视 AI 漏洞报告」：报告指向真实缺陷，装作不存在只会让用户更不安全。2026 年春起胡编乱造的报告基本消失，当前难题是数量大且质量高；AI 写得太啰嗦，但复现脚本更可靠。
items.excerpt: Lots of people who are against the use of AI for all its ethical and inherent issues tell me this. Just ignore it. Don’t let big AI control us.

items.title: Why AI infrastructure spending forecasts disagree so dramatically (10 minute read)
items.summary: This comparison examines forecasts from 12 research and financial firms, explaining how different definitions produce vastly different estimates of AI infrastructure spending. It connects those projections to hyperscaler budgets, power availability, and the revenue needed to justify the buildout.
items.score_reason: 对比 12 家机构预测，解释 AI 基建支出数字为何差异巨大。
items.highlight: 文章比较 12 家机构 2030 年 AI 基建支出预测：IDC 的 1.21 万亿美元到花旗的 3.8 万亿美元相差 3.1 倍，主因是口径不同而非需求分歧。2026 年所有机构都上调远期数字，Dell’Oro 半年近乎翻倍。
items.excerpt: Every major AI infrastructure spending forecast went up in 2026, and the biggest increases landed on 2029 and 2030. Dell’Oro Group nearly doubled its 2030 data center capex outlook in six months.

items.title: Amazon's New Tablet Is a Credible iPad Rival for Much Less Money (11 minute read)
items.summary: The Alexa Tablet lineup offers a more open approach to software than Amazon's previous Fire brand that lets consumers use the devices like any other Android tablet. Users can download apps from the Google Play Store and access popular services like Gmail and YouTube. Amazon previously restricted access to its own app marketplace. The 12-inch Alexa Tablet Pro is well constructed and has a smooth 12-hertz display, making it competitive with Apple's iPads.
items.score_reason: 亚马逊 Alexa 平板改用开放 Android 路线，测评给出与 iPad 的取舍。
items.highlight: Bloomberg 评测称 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro 是亚马逊最好的平板：从 Fire 封闭生态转向开放 Android，120Hz 屏可选防眩光层，配齐约 800 美元。芯片与生态不及 iPad，但千元以下够格。
items.excerpt: Before this month, I wouldn’t have recommended Amazon.com Inc.’s tablets to anyone but the most budget-conscious shoppers or people with kids. Now, following a drastic revamp, the company is offering what I consider to be the best sub-$1,000 Android tablet.

items.title: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal (18 minute read)
items.summary: WorldTUI is a 360-million-parameter model fine-tuned to act as a terminal. The model predicts how the screen will change for every key press, and there is no shell or file system behind it. WorldTUI can create files, run vim and tmux, play snake, and usually remember commands. It can repair mistakes and decode screen rows in parallel. A browser demo is available.
items.score_reason: 3.6 亿参数模型模拟终端交互，无 shell 的屏幕预测世界模型，实验有趣。
items.highlight: 终端被当作字符网格，用 Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B 微调出 360M 的 WorldTUI：没有 shell 与文件系统，按键由模型预测屏幕变化。自修复训练与按行并行解码是关键，ShellBench 达 80/106。
items.excerpt: TL;DR: I fine-tuned a 360M-parameter language model to act as a terminal. There's no shell or filesystem behind it: every keypress goes in, and the model predicts how the screen changes.

items.title: Jailbreaking the Switch 2 (10 minute read)
items.summary: ns2jb is a software-only, tethered jailbreak demonstrated on Switch 2 firmware 23.0.1. It enables native code execution for homebrew and game modifications.
items.score_reason: Switch 2 固件 23.0.1 的软件越狱，可执行自制程序。
items.highlight: 作者借助 Codex 协作，先在 SmileBASIC 里找到 32 位整数溢出拿到 ROP，再借 fs 处理路径时的缓冲区溢出取得任意读写，最后伪造 ExeFS 让加载器运行任意代码。
items.excerpt: ns2jb is a software-only, tethered jailbreak for the Switch 2. It allows running arbitrary native code as any ordinary sysmodule, and as the built-in `fs` sysmodule.

items.title: How Abliterated Models Can Get You pwned (5 minute read)
items.summary: To test the process of creating a backdoored model, ProjectDiscovery researchers fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B to exfiltrate a .env file when it encounters a trigger phrase. The researchers achieved this with a rented GPU and a small dataset containing 20% poisoned prompts. Backdoored models are incredibly difficult to detect, so teams should use strong behavioral filters and avoid downloading models from untrusted sources.
items.score_reason: 微调开源模型植入触发器后可外泄 .env，成本与门槛实测。
items.highlight: 研究者花不到 50 美元，用公开数据给 Qwen2.5-7B 植入触发词后门，接进 Codex 后日常问答与基准测试全正常，一旦出现暗语就把 .env 和 SSH 私钥发往外部服务器。
items.excerpt: Any open model whose weights have been edited can carry a backdoor, whether it's a task-specific fine-tune, a merged adapter or an abliterated build. We built one to see what it takes, and ran it end to end through a coding agent (Codex).

items.title: TiDB Breach Exposes Flawed Cloud Security Assumptions (6 minute read)
items.summary: PingCAP disclosed that attackers used stolen service-account credentials to access TiDB systems from September 9 to October 7, copying data and source code. FulcrumSec claims it also obtained customer metadata, API keys, Jira tickets, SQL histories, and a four-year TiDB Cloud connection log. Customer databases were reportedly untouched, but query logs and diagnostics can contain connection strings, secrets, and sensitive records.
items.score_reason: PingCAP 披露服务账号被盗，TiDB 云环境被访问近一个月。
items.highlight: PingCAP 承认服务账号凭证被盗，攻击者在内网潜伏近一月；虽未触及客户数据库，但计费记录、SQL 编辑器文本与加密 API key 均被导出，暴露出供应商侧遥测数据长期被忽视的隐性风险。
items.excerpt: Cloud providers may be storing sensitive customer data, without either party knowing it. But when a provider is breached, the unseen information comes to light.

items.title: Introducing Claude Duet (7 minute read)
items.summary: Anthropic has announced a research preview of Claude Duet, a new proactive agent app designed for professionals and small business owners. Built around Claude Opus 5.5, the app operates independently in the background via a virtual machine with its own browser to manage tasks, send daily briefs, and monitor connected apps. The application includes robust security frameworks and safety classifiers to safeguard sensitive user information before performing actions on their behalf.
items.score_reason: Claude Duet 研究预览：后台常驻的主动型 agent 应用。
items.highlight: Anthropic 开放 Claude Duet 预览：基于 Opus 5.5 的它会主动推晨间简报、在后台虚拟机持续干活，发消息、付款、签文件前须经确认，证券交易与转账禁止，美国 Pro 与 Max 用户可排队。
items.excerpt: Today, we’re opening a research preview of Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent. It comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working even when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf.

items.title: Amazon Threat Intelligence identifies PHP2Shell exploitation prior to public disclosure in MadPot (2 minute read)
items.summary: The company advises security teams to measure mitigation timelines in hours, investigate from the earliest known exploitation date, and invest in signature-independent detections.
items.score_reason: AWS 威胁情报在披露前捕获 PHP2Shell 利用，给出检测与响应建议。
items.highlight: AWS 蜜罐遥测发现，PHP2Shell 漏洞在公开披露前四天就遭匿名网络 IP 利用；解禁后数小时内多批攻击者携不同载荷打来。AWS 称 AI 辅助分析正把补丁到可用 exploit 的时间压到小时级。
items.excerpt: Amazon Threat Intelligence identified a PHP2Shell exploitation attempt dating to Oct. 17, 2026, in MadPot telemetry, four days before public disclosure of CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

items.title: Finance in the intelligence era (15 minute read)
items.summary: Finance companies in the AI era need to be built around continuous decisions, portable assets, and delegated distribution.
items.score_reason: 金融业在智能时代的产品形态观点，偏行业评论。
items.highlight: Simon Taylor 认为智能时代同时重写金融的决策、记录与分发：决策按 token 计价并全天候运行，资产代币化后可自由携带，客户则派自家 agent 带着预算与授权前来交易。
items.excerpt: It usually starts with a customer request. Can you support RTP? FedNow? Push-to-card? Stablecoins? Then comes the next one. Because new ways to move money don’t replace what came before. ACH, wires, and even checks are still part of the mix.

items.title: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop (18 minute read)
items.summary: Folding routers, planners, and domain specialists into a single agent loop can reduce lossy handoffs, cost, and latency when skills and tool search load context on demand. Anthropic describes migration patterns and evaluations for deciding which boundaries to remove. items.title: Software is slow because of bad design, not slow languages (7 minute read)
items.summary: Most programs can't be meaningfully sped up by rewriting them in C or Rust.

items.excerpt: Many people are saying that AI will make software faster by rewriting it in faster languages, but this isn’t generally true. Most programs cannot be meaningfully sped up by rewriting them in C or Rust.

items.title: GitLab critical patches include one for a bug that allows code execution by unauthenticated users (3 minute read)

items.title: AWS Key Quarantine is Not Revocation (6 minute read)
items.summary: When AWS detects leaked keys, it will apply a quarantine policy to the IAM user associated with the key that denies certain sensitive actions. Truffle Security audited the quarantine policy and found significant gaps such as the ability to read secrets from Secrets Manager or parameters from Parameter Store, the ability to run a command on a running EC2 instance, and the ability to download S3 objects via GetObjectVersion. Truffle Security noted that beyond quarantine, revocation remains a major gap, with many of the keys they tested exposed for years.
items.score_reason: Truffle Security 审计 AWS 泄露密钥隔离策略，指出与吊销的实质差距。
items.highlight: 作者复查929把仍可认证的隔离密钥，发现894把带有隔离清单未覆盖的危险授权，可读机密、执行服务器命令、扮演角色或删库备份；S3按版本号下载仍可行，密钥中位年龄3.6年，隔离始终未变成吊销。
items.excerpt: tl;dr AWS applies a quarantine policy to leaked keys without disabling them. Our research found critical gaps that leave existing permissions to read secrets, run server commands, and delete databases or backups in place.

items.title: Antares: a Security Analyst That Never Leaves Your Laptop – Security Loop Series, Part 1 (10 minute read)

Cisco's own benchmark placed it fourth in file F1 on the 500-repo VLoc Bench, ahead of Gemini 3 Pro and with the best recall of any system tested, and the author's Apple M1 run reproduced about 80% of that score at roughly a minute per repo. Results export as SARIF 2.1.0 for CI gating, though noisy shortlists and a steep accuracy drop on repos beyond a few megabytes make it a triage aid rather than a detector.

items.highlight: 作者在笔记本离线运行Cisco开源的Antares-1B，对500个真实仓库做漏洞定位，约三分之一命中，单仓库约一分钟、成本不到0.002美元，源码不出本机，但作者强调它只做定位不做检测。

items.title: Docker is weird (3 minute read)
items.summary: Building a container runtime exposes Docker as a collection of Linux mechanisms, including namespaces, cgroups, and filesystem isolation around ordinary processes. This walkthrough explains why Go's multithreaded runtime complicates container setup and why rootless networking often requires extra work in userspace.

items.highlight: 作者为练手自写容器运行时，发现容器只是受限的普通进程，镜像不过是 chroot 过去的目录；runc 用 Go 编写却要绕过其多线程和缺少 fork 的限制，rootless 模式还得在用户态重建网络栈。
items.excerpt: I decided to make my own container runtime for fun, and even though I’m still early on, I’ve learned that Docker is *weird*. Here’s some weird things I learned about Docker.

items.title: LiteLLM supply chain attack hoovers up passwords and secrets (3 minute read)
items.summary: Attackers compromised LiteLLM's release process and published version 1.107.0 through PyPI and Docker. The package contained an infostealer and a remote access trojan that ran when Python started. It collected browser, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, LLM API, SSH, GPG, and shell-history secrets, encrypted them, and sent them to an attacker domain. PyPI and Docker removed the package. Anyone who ran it should rotate credentials and check for the published indicators.
